snippet.title: SLACKJAW - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
About the upcoming horror game SLACKJAW: As the latest prey of a deranged serial killer, you must use your wits and resources to survive in this atmospheric first-person escape room-style horror game. Explore, uncover secrets, and plan your escape... but be quiet, or you'll be his next victim. Inspired by true events. Coming August 8th, 2025. 

Wishlist "SLACKJAW" now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073900/SLACKJAW/

Socials:
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/r47gmJ3z6R
Website: https://www.taylorambrosiowood.com/nostromo
Support: https://ko-fi.com/nostromo

If you are a streamer and would like to request a Steam key, please contact me through my email or my website contact form. Thank you!
